title: A note can be a question, and the answer comes back on the card

options.label: Yes: note → my answer under it → answered, never re-sent
options.act: Per-note state (asked/answered), agent reply under the note; answered notes excluded from the next send
options.then: Answer question notes under the note itself, mark them answered, and never send them again.

why: Fixes the notes that kept coming back. When your note is a question, I answer it under the note, on the same card, and mark it answered; the card's recommendation updates if the answer changes it. Answered notes aren't sent again. It works like a resolved comment thread in Vercel or Figma.
It also makes "ask a question" a first-class answer, beside picking an option: what you did on most cards this week.
